card.name: Space before a number in time ranges
card.fires_on: The space or small word just before a number that ends a range or limit, such as 'up to', 'until' or 'to', most often before hours or liters in prep and imaging instructions.

modes.label: Space after 'up to'
modes.description: The blank before a number after 'up to' or 'until' giving a time or volume limit.

modes.description: The word 'to' after 'up' before a multiple of the upper limit.

modes.label: Range start
modes.description: The blank before a number following 'to' in a time window.
